mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Federal Funds rate signals monetary easing that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal Funds rate exceeding 4.5% triggers expectations of restrictive policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in payroll employment signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts during late-cycle expansion signal sustained consumer demand strength, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods with rising HOUST, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate indicates economic weakness that reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with rising UNRATE, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% triggers expectations of prolonged monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising Federal Funds rate combined with falling unemployment rate signals a strong economy that can withstand tightening, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances with rising FEDFUNDS and falling UNRATE, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production during post-shock recovery indicates manufacturing rebound, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of post-shock recovery periods with rising INDPRO, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
